articles.summary: We have just launched OpenReplay Spot, our new Chrome extension that makes bug reporting blazingly fast and simple. With Spot, you can record bugs directly from your browser — each recording includes all the technical details needed to fix them: console logs, errors, network payloads, user agent data, and activity. Getting started with Spot is fast: Add the Spot extension to your Chrome browser. Create an account if you don’t have one on OpenReplay. Pin Spot and click on its icon to start re...
articles.title: Meet OpenReplay Spot - our new Chrome extension for bug reporting!
